classification: Difficulty describes assumed knowledge; content type describes the learning activity.

beginner.label: Beginner
beginner.description: No previous AI evaluation experience. Lessons may build on earlier beginner steps.

intermediate.label: Intermediate
intermediate.description: Assumes the basics of test cases, grading, and evaluation design. Plans may require coding.

advanced.label: Advanced
advanced.description: Assumes implementation experience plus the relevant statistics, agent, or production knowledge.

beginner_path.goal: Understand the task → expected behavior → grade → decision loop.
Write a clear definition of a passing answer.
Choose cases that reveal useful differences and failures.
Choose a person, rule, or model to judge the evidence.
Define clarification, abstention, and action boundaries.
Connect the evidence to an accountable decision.
Complete a five-case evaluation and write a next-action plan.

lessons.title: What is an AI evaluation?
lessons.outcome: Explain what an eval tests and name its four basic pieces.

lessons.title: Build a useful golden set
lessons.outcome: Create a small set of test cases with expected behavior and provenance.

lessons.title: Design human labeling and adjudication
lessons.outcome: Plan independent labels and a process for resolving disagreements.
terms: Anchor: an independently reviewed example used to check a grader.
Adjudication: a domain reviewer resolves a material labeling disagreement.

lessons.title: Map dataset coverage and contamination
lessons.outcome: Identify missing dataset slices and possible overlap with training data.
terms: Slice: a meaningful group of cases, such as a task, language, or risk level.
Held-out set: cases kept separate from training and iterative development.

lessons.title: Define success before scoring
lessons.outcome: Describe success using observable criteria instead of a vague quality score.

lessons.title: Set quality, latency, and cost budgets
lessons.outcome: Set task-level quality, cost, and latency constraints.
terms: p95 latency: 95% of measured task durations are at or below this value.

lessons.title: Write an evaluation specification
lessons.outcome: Write a versioned evaluation plan that connects evidence to a decision.

lessons.title: Choose the right kind of grader
lessons.outcome: Choose a suitable grading approach and explain its limitations.

lessons.title: Interpret differences and uncertainty
lessons.outcome: Distinguish effect size, percentage points, and uncertainty.
terms: Paired comparison: both systems are tested on the same tasks.
Percentage point: the absolute difference between percentages; 80% to 82% adds 2 points.

lessons.title: Evaluate outcomes and trajectories
lessons.outcome: Separate final task outcomes from the sequence of agent actions.
terms: Agent: an AI workflow that can choose actions and call tools.
Trajectory: the recorded sequence of actions, tool calls, and results.

lessons.title: Evaluate retrieval, support, and abstention
lessons.outcome: Test whether a retrieval-based answer is supported by its evidence.
terms: RAG (retrieval-augmented generation): retrieving documents to help an AI answer.
Grounding: supporting answer claims with the available evidence.

lessons.title: Test the boundaries around an agent
lessons.outcome: Map untrusted inputs, permissions, and forbidden outcomes.
terms: Prompt injection: untrusted content attempts to redirect the system’s behavior.
Threat model: a structured account of what could go wrong and where the boundaries are.

lessons.title: Extend evaluation to voice and multimodal systems
lessons.outcome: Identify failures across voice, visual, and interaction stages.
terms: Multimodal: working with more than one form of information, such as text, voice, or images.

lessons.title: Connect evidence to a release decision
lessons.outcome: Describe the evidence, owner, and follow-up needed for a release decision.

lessons.title: Monitor quality after release
lessons.outcome: Plan quality review and response ownership after release.
terms: Drift: a change in inputs, measured behavior, or outcomes over time.

lessons.title: Write a methodology others can inspect
lessons.outcome: Write a reviewable account of the claim, method, evidence, and limits.

lessons.title: What should happen when the AI cannot answer?
lessons.outcome: Specify what the system should do when evidence or authority is missing.

lessons.title: Run your first evaluation without code
lessons.outcome: Grade a small example, explain failures, and propose a next action.

project_plans.title: Trajectory Grading Engine
project_plans.outcome: Build and validate checks for tool calls and required steps.

project_plans.title: Shadow Routing Comparator
project_plans.outcome: Design an isolated comparison path for live workload samples.
project_plans.assumes: Production request routing, tracing, and isolation of state-changing tools.

project_plans.title: Calibrated LLM-as-a-Judge
project_plans.outcome: Build a judge-calibration process against independent human labels.

project_plans.title: CI/CD Regression Gate
project_plans.outcome: Implement a release policy as a check that can block a candidate.

project_plans.title: RAG Adversarial Harness
project_plans.outcome: Build controlled context perturbations and grounding checks.

project_plans.title: Automated DPO Flywheel
project_plans.outcome: Design a reviewed feedback-to-training pipeline with independent evaluation.
project_plans.assumes: Preference learning, fine-tuning, dataset governance, and candidate model release.

project_plans.title: Statistical Significance Engine
project_plans.assumes: Paired data, dependence, confidence intervals, and implementing a resampling method.

project_plans.title: Agent Red-Team Fuzzer
project_plans.outcome: Build an isolated adversarial harness and a reproducible failure corpus.

project_plans.title: Production Drift Monitor
project_plans.outcome: Build a sampling and alerting system that distinguishes signals from causes.
project_plans.assumes: Production instrumentation, sampling, and alert ownership.

project_plans.title: Cost–Quality Pareto Dashboard
project_plans.outcome: Compare constrained cost-quality tradeoffs using measured outcomes.

project_plans.title: Counterfactual Replay Debugger
project_plans.outcome: Design state capture and a controlled replay intervention.
project_plans.assumes: Recorded state, dependency graphs, and isolated replay of external tools.

project_plans.title: Synthetic Edge-Case Generator
project_plans.outcome: Generate, review, and deduplicate candidate edge cases.

project_plans.title: Context Window Eviction Tester
project_plans.outcome: Measure retention and recovery under controlled context pressure.
project_plans.assumes: Agent memory policies, token budgets, and controlled long-running tasks.

project_plans.title: Dataset Contamination Checker
project_plans.outcome: Implement overlap detection with reviewed exclusion decisions.

project_plans.title: Public Eval Methodology Teardown
project_plans.outcome: Produce a reproducible methodology and evidence package.

trace.outcome: Spot a step-level failure that a fluent final answer can hide.

judge.outcome: See why answer order and length can distort a judge’s preference.

gate.outcome: See how explicit acceptance criteria change a release verdict.
